title: erigeron uniflorus f. pallidus
intro: Erigeron uniflorus f. pallidus, commonly known as pale flowered fleabane or pale daisy, is a subspecies of the Erigeron uniflorus plant. This perennial herb is native to the mountainous regions of North America and is known for its pale-colored flowers. The health benefits of Erigeron uniflorus f. pallidus include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
